snippet.title: Hungry Horrors - Full Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Hungry Horrors 1.0 is out now on Steam!

A curse has made the kingdom ravenous, turning mythical monsters into Hungry Horrors. You are the spoilt Princess, who would much rather stay in bed than go on any adventure. Luckily, you don’t have to fight. Cook the right dish, serve it up and feed each Horror before it reaches you and feeds on you.

Hungry Horrors is a deckbuilding adventure rooted in British and Irish mythology, folklore and cuisine. Every dish is a real British or Irish recipe and every Horror comes from actual legend. It’s turn based with no time pressure, with a colourful 90s cartoon look in hand pixelled art and bespoke original music that’s whimsical, creepy and cosy.

FULL RELEASE

8 biomes across the British Isles
34 Horrors, each with its own unique way of finishing the Princess
62 dishes
13 legendary characters
33 unique death animations
Campaign mode, with Vanilla or Spicy difficulty
Banquet mode, a shorter, harder roguelike
Localised into 14 languages
Steam Deck Verified and available on GeForce NOW

The game was shaped directly by community feedback through Early Access, and we’re so grateful to everyone who played along the way.

Hungry Horrors is also part of the Roguelike Celebration 2026 sale on Steam, with 20% off from 12 to 19 October.

Wishlist, buy or play on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048840/Hungry_Horrors/
Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/v4TufU5bsB

Hungry Horrors is developed and self published by Clumsy Bear Studio.
Music by Henry Taylor.

#HungryHorrors #Deckbuilder #Roguelike #indiegame #indiedev
